messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-Inf-8473 triggered for inference-cell-3 — queue backlog > 95% for 31m. Auto-remediation: none.

pagerduty-bot: page fired to @on-call (rotation: alex). Incident link: https://pd.example/PD-Inf-8473

alex: acked. on it. pulling metrics and kube.

maria: seeing enqueue_rate spike x6, new requests mostly long-context. Pods not scaling: scale-controller logs show repeated handshake_timeouts to node-provisioner.

ryan: noticing KV cache priming jobs stuck in Init, steady Pending nodes due to 'device quota' from cloud provider.

jane: customer-facing support — Customer 'Acme' reported 504s and timeouts starting ~20m ago. ETA on mitigation?

todd: starting manual ramp: kubectl scale deploy/inference-hotpath --replicas=12 ; also requesting extra quota from cloud console.

alex: running quick diagnostics:
```
# kubectl get pods -n inference --selector=cell=inference-cell-3
NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
hotpath-0                        0/2     Init:0/1  0          45m
hotpath-1                        2/2     Running   0          10m
scale-controller-7f8b6c9d4-abc   1/1     Running   0          1d
```

alex: logs show scale-controller failing to attach node labels due to IAM quota errors: `AttachVolume: Exceeded quota`.

maria: temp mitigation — switching route for low-priority orgs to model-compact v2 (lower memory) via gateway rule. Pushing now.

ryan: evicting noncritical batch jobs on nodepool 'spot-warm' to free GPUs.

support-bot: Sent customer notice to affected tenants: short blurb + advisory. (ID: MSG-921)

jane: coordinating CS updates. Will send a readout once queue drains below 40%.

todd: cloud quota request approved for +4 GPUs. Spinning nodes now, but kube provisioning taking ~4-6m due to init scripts.

alex: monitoring head_latency and queue depth. If no improvement in 8m, escalate to SRE lead @michael.

pagerduty-bot: will escalate in 8m if status unchanged.

maria: after reroute and manual scale, queue depth moved from 98% -> 62% in 3m. Latency reduced 30%.

ryan: nodes coming up; hotpath pods entering Running.

alex: observed further improvement. keeping page open until stable.

support-bot: Sent interim update to affected customers (Acme + 3) with mitigation status.

jane: tagging post-incident follow-up: investigate warmup/blockade in KV priming and add guardrails to scale-controller (retry/backoff).

alex: handoff — if queue < 40% and head latency < 200ms for 10m, I'll resolve. Otherwise @michael take over.

pagerduty-bot: ack recorded by alex. Next update at +10m or on status change.

incident-bot: Last check: queue depth 38%, head_latency 180ms, backlog draining. No further paging.

alex: resolving page. creating PD postmortem ticket PD-Inf-8473-POSTMORTEM and linking this thread.

support-bot: Final customer update queued. Closing internal comms once postmortem created.
